We all have our favorites when it comes to the films of Stanley Kubrick but we don't really bring up our least favorite(s). Share your least favorite Kurbick film(s) and discuss your opinion.
What is your least favorite Kubrick film(s) and why?

I've always felt that Full Metal Jacket could have been better. The story feels like it's wandering rather aimlessly at times, and the structure is unbalanced with a first part at boot camp and a mostly unrelated part on active duty.

On the other hand, both The Killing and Killer's Kiss are not extraordinary. It's clear that he was still learning with those (I haven't seen Fear and Desire, it might be similar). That's not to say they aren't good; for lesser directors they could be their best pieces. But they aren't ten star material.
The Shining, it's so good it traumatized me as a kid, and I can't watch it again

The Shining...... I heard it was great, but I didn't see the appeal when I watched it.

Another voat for Eyes Wide Shut. Cruise and Kidman were not bad in it I thought, but it was just an okay film until Kubrick died and someone else finished off the shooting. The tonal change was so significant that it brought whatever momentum the film had to a sudden halt, not to mention I had the strong feeling that the script was played with.

Barry Lyndon (sp?) is a strong second. It was too long even when it came out and Ryan O'Neil has always been a questionable casting choice. I tried to re-watch it recently but the plodding pace was now unwatchable for me.
